description:
Company Overview:

PartsBase Inc. is the world's largest online Aviation Marketplace and Community. Our global community is comprised of over 6,500 companies accessing our technology in over 140+ countries & territories. We work with some of the biggest brands in aviation including Delta, Northrop Gruman, AvAir, Heico, Chevron, Air France Industries, and Air Australia.

PartsBase offers a FULLY remote environment where one can work at the forefront of where the aviation business meets technology. Imagine getting to work with peers worldwide, implementing business technology projects that challenge the boundaries.

Life at PartsBase:

One of the top benefits of working at PartsBase is the culture. We are a TEAM-focused organization, and everyone celebrates each other's successes. Our inclusive culture welcomes all employees and values their unique contributions to our success. Our clients tell us time and time again that our people set us apart from the competition. We naturally strive to hire the very best talent. The ideal candidate is a motivated, well-organized individual who has a deep understanding of prospecting and developing strong relationships with customers.

The Role

We’re looking for a sourcer who lives in LinkedIn Recruiter and isn’t afraid to go find talent that isn’t looking. This role is built around two things: sourcing passive sales talent for our AE and SDR roles, and coordinating interviews.

You won’t own the full recruiting cycle. You’ll build and warm the pipeline, bring qualified candidates to the Talent team and hiring managers, and keep the interview process running smoothly. LinkedIn Recruiter is your primary tool, and we expect you to know it inside and out. Agency experience is a big plus.

What You’ll Do

Sourcing in LinkedIn Recruiter

  • Use LinkedIn Recruiter daily as your primary sourcing tool: advanced filters (title, company, industry, seniority, skills, geography, Open to Work), saved searches, and search alerts.

  • Build and refine boolean strings and run X-ray searches that surface passive candidates others miss.

  • Create and manage Projects and pipelines in Recruiter, organized by role and stage and kept current.

  • Build talent maps of target companies and competitors for AE and SDR roles so pipelines are full before roles open.

  • Write personalized InMail and multi-touch outreach sequences, and test subject lines and messaging to lift response rates.

  • Use Recruiter outreach analytics (InMail acceptance and response rates) to refine your approach and manage InMail credits wisely.

  • Supplement LinkedIn with social media, communities, and job boards.

  • Run brief initial screens to confirm interest, background, and compensation alignment before handing candidates to the Talent team and hiring managers.

  • Keep candidate information in sync between LinkedIn Recruiter and our ATS (Ashby).

  • Track and report sourcing KPIs weekly: InMail response rate, pipeline conversion, and candidates passed to hiring managers.

  • Stay current on LinkedIn Recruiter features and sourcing trends.

Interview coordination

  • Schedule interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and the Talent team, including multi-round and panel interviews.

  • Send clear communications and reminders so candidates know what to expect at each stage.

  • Keep candidate statuses and interview details up to date in the ATS.

  • Follow up with candidates promptly and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define ideal candidate profiles and search criteria.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 2+ years of sourcing experience (or recruiting with a heavy sourcing focus), ideally in agency or high-volume environments.

  • Extensive, hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter. You should be a power user of advanced search filters, boolean strings, Projects, pipeline management, InMail, saved searches, and outreach analytics.

  • Advanced boolean and X-ray search skills.

  • Proven track record of building talent pipelines from scratch and winning over passive candidates.

  • Experience sourcing for AEs, SDRs, or other sales roles in SaaS or tech.

  • Experience scheduling and coordinating interviews across multiple stakeholders.

  • Comfort with cold outreach and persistence, with no fear of picking up the phone or sending the 5th follow-up.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple searches and schedules at once.

Preferred:

  • LinkedIn Recruiter certification.

  • Agency recruiting background.

  • Experience with an ATS (such as Ashby), job boards, and social media sourcing.

  • Familiarity with sourcing and automation tools (e.g., contact-finding and outreach platforms).

  • Critical thinker, problem solver, and team player with a strong sense of ownership.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $60,000 – $70,000, based on experience

Our Interview Process

We keep it straightforward and respectful of your time:

  1. First Round: Conversation with our Director of Talent, focused on your background, sourcing approach, and LinkedIn Recruiter expertise.

  2. Second Round: Meet the Talent Acquisition team, where you’ll get a feel for how we work together and show us how you think.
